cinema.label: how
cinema.html: ← back # How it works ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── There is no video decoder at runtime A .tvf pack is a header plus a run of independently-decodable JPEG frames, already scaled to about twice the sub-cell grid. ffmpeg builds it once, ahead of time. Playing it back is a 0.6 ms JPEG decode into the same resampler, glyph fitter and ANSI writer that draw a still image. A .gif needs no tooling at all — the GIF decoder is pure TypeScript.
